senses.gloss: f. (transpos. of תסכפית; v. סָכַף) band of oppressors, band of demons.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 51a:13">Ber. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ … של מלאכי חבלה וכ׳</he> a band of demons, and some say, a ‘cluster’ of angels of destruction, v. <cite ref="A01412"><he>אִיסְטַגְלִילִית</he></cite>; [Var. lect., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.]
